text_to_image_prompt: Use case: product-mockup. One complete styled outfit, photorealistic product catalog image, portrait 2:3, pure white seamless background, soft studio light. Invisible hollow clothing with no person, body, skin or visible mannequin. Clothing: Open burgundy and cream plaid overshirt over ivory pointed-collar shirt, heavily faded gray-blue extra wide jeans with cream ribbon lacing along outer lower legs, beige gray chunky sneakers. No emblems.  Accessories: One burgundy woven necktie with thin diagonal ivory and charcoal stripes, loosely knotted, full length visible. ; One dark brown almost-black leather belt with aged oval brass buckle, gently coiled. ; One small ivory stuffed rabbit keychain with long ears attached to silver ring and short brown cord. No other accessories.  All attachable accessories worn naturally on the ensemble at realistic scale. Unattachable tiny accessories arranged adjacent to the ensemble. Full uncropped framing, no text, logos or watermark.
original_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Remove the unrequested brown shoulder bag and its shoulder strap completely. Keep the ivory stuffed rabbit keychain but reduce it to a realistic small keychain size and attach its metal ring directly to a front jeans belt loop at hip. Keep all other clothing, burgundy plaid overshirt, white shirt, burgundy striped tie, dark leather belt, faded wide jeans with cream side ribbons, shoes, pure white background, natural lighting, hollow mannequin-free structure and framing unchanged. No bag, no person or skin.
